# Differential test vectors - cash wallet add (Team D, original game as oracle)

Companion data for `spec-differential-results.md` D-22. Amounts are raw cash (cents). The add is for the local player; "cash multiplier" is the global cash-gain multiplier raised by the `Cash_Bonus_*` / `Cash_Bonus_Modifier` unlockables (1.0 at a new game). Expected = new cash after the add.
